#![forbid(unsafe_code)]

use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicBool;
use te1_chess::{START_FEN, Te1Game};
use te1_search::{CorrectionRawSignal, SearchLimits, SearchOptions, SearchResult, search, set_correction_raw_profile};
use te1_tt::TranspositionTable;

struct Spec {
    id: &'static str,
    fen: &'static str,
    moves: &'static str,
}
const DEPTH: u8 = 8;
const POSITIONS: &[Spec] = &[
    Spec {
        id: "startpos",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "ruy_lopez",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1b5 a7a6 b5a4 g8f6 e1g1 f8e7",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "nimzo_indian",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 g8f6 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 f8b4 e2e3 e8g8 f1d3 d7d5",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "sicilian_classical",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 c7c5 g1f3 d7d6 d2d4 c5d4 f3d4 g8f6 b1c3 b8c6",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "queens_gambit",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 d7d5 c2c4 e7e6 b1c3 g8f6 c1g5 f8e7 e2e3 e8g8",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "caro_kann_advance",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "e2e4 c7c6 d2d4 d7d5 e4e5 c8f5 g1f3 e7e6 f1e2",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "english_four_knights",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "c2c4 e7e5 b1c3 g8f6 g1f3 b8c6 g2g3 f8b4 f1g2 e8g8",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "kings_indian",
        fen: START_FEN,
        moves: "d2d4 g8f6 c2c4 g7g6 b1c3 f8g7 e2e4 d7d6 g1f3 e8g8",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "kiwipete_family",
        fen: "r3k2r/p1ppqpb1/bn2pnp1/2pP4/1p2P3/2N2N2/PPQBBPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
        moves: "",
    },
    Spec {
        id: "quiet_middlegame",
        fen: "2r2rk1/pp1nbppp/2p1pn2/q2p4/3P4/2N1PN2/PPQ1BPPP/2RR2K1 w - - 0 1",
        moves: "",
    },
];

fn run(spec: &Spec, on: bool) -> SearchResult {
    set_correction_raw_profile(on);
    let mut game = Te1Game::from_fen(spec.fen).unwrap();
    for mv in spec.moves.split_whitespace() {
        game.play_uci(mv).unwrap();
    }
    search(
        &game,
        SearchLimits {
            depth: Some(DEPTH),
            ..Default::default()
        },
        Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
        Arc::new(TranspositionTable::with_megabytes(16)),
        SearchOptions {
            threads: 1,
            deterministic: true,
            use_lmr: true,
            use_see_pruning: true,
            use_null_move_pruning: true,
        },
    )
    .unwrap()
}
fn profile_json(p: &CorrectionRawSignal) -> String {
    let suppressed = p.suppressed.iter().map(|(k,v)| format!(r#""{}":{}"#,k,v)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",");
    let samples = p.samples.iter().map(|x| format!(r#"{{"error":{},"depth":{},"bound":"{}","side":"{}","pawn_key":"{}"}}"#,x.error,x.depth,x.bound,x.side,x.pawn_key)).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",");
    format!(r#"{{"inspected":{},"suppressed":{{{}}},"samples":[{}]}}"#,p.inspected,suppressed,samples)
}
fn semantic(r: &SearchResult) -> String {
    format!(
        "{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}|{}",
        r.best_move.as_deref().unwrap_or("0000"),
        r.score_cp,
        r.depth,
        r.seldepth,
        r.nodes,
        r.qnodes,
        r.stopped,
        r.pv.join(",")
    )
}
fn main() {
    te1_eval::use_embedded_nnue().unwrap();
    te1_eval::set_nnue_enabled(true);
    te1_eval::set_hybrid_enabled(false);
    println!(
        "TE1_CORRECTION_RAW_META\tschema=v1\tevaluator={}",
        te1_eval::evaluator_name()
    );
    for spec in POSITIONS {
        let off = run(spec, false);
        let on = run(spec, true);
        assert_eq!(semantic(&off), semantic(&on), "OFF/ON drift {}", spec.id);
        assert_eq!(off.correction_raw_signal, CorrectionRawSignal::default());
        println!(
            "TE1_CORRECTION_RAW\tid={}\tsemantic={}\tprofile={}",
            spec.id,
            semantic(&on),
            profile_json(&on.correction_raw_signal)
        );
    }
}
